a bare raise inside an except block (no `from`) produces Python's own implicit 'During handling of the above exception' text -- proving chaining happens even when a caller never asked for it

checks.describe: a handler set to WARNING never emits a DEBUG record even though the logger itself is set to DEBUG -- section 4's two-gate pipeline proof
checks.run:
python3 -c "
import logging, sys

logger = logging.getLogger('m7dd-check')
logger.setLevel(logging.DEBUG)
logger.handlers = []

quiet = logging.StreamHandler(sys.stdout)
quiet.setLevel(logging.WARNING)
quiet.setFormatter(logging.Formatter('QUIET %(levelname)s'))
logger.addHandler(quiet)

logger.debug('loading service.yaml')
logger.warning('validation failed')
"
